@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+Add ``splitApiServersIntoCoreAndExecution`` option to run the Execution API in a dedicated Deployment
+
+When enabled, the existing api-server Deployment is restricted to ``--apps core`` and a new
+``<release>-execution-api-server`` Deployment plus internal-only (ClusterIP) Service is created
+with ``--apps execution``. The ``[core] execution_api_server_url`` value rendered into the
+Airflow config is rewritten so workers, the triggerer and the dag-processor connect to the new
+internal Service. Default is ``false`` (single combined api-server Deployment), so existing
+deployments are unaffected.

+##########################################
+## Airflow Execution API Server HPA
+##########################################
+{{- if and .Values.apiServer.enabled .Values.splitApiServersIntoCoreAndExecution .Values.apiServer.hpa.enabled }}
+apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
+kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
+metadata:
+  name: {{ include "airflow.fullname" . }}-execution-api-server
+  labels:
+    tier: airflow
+    component: execution-api-server-horizontalpodautoscaler
+    release: {{ .Release.Name }}
+    chart: "{{ .Chart.Name }}-{{ .Chart.Version }}"
+    heritage: {{ .Release.Service }}
+    deploymentName: {{ .Release.Name }}-execution-api-server
+    {{- if or .Values.labels .Values.apiServer.labels }}
+      {{- mustMerge .Values.apiServer.labels .Values.labels | toYaml | nindent 4 }}
+    {{- end }}
+spec:
+  scaleTargetRef:
+    apiVersion: apps/v1
+    kind: Deployment
+    name: {{ include "airflow.fullname" . }}-execution-api-server
+  minReplicas: {{ .Values.apiServer.hpa.minReplicaCount }}
+  maxReplicas: {{ .Values.apiServer.hpa.maxReplicaCount }}
+  metrics: {{- toYaml .Values.apiServer.hpa.metrics | nindent 4 }}
+  {{- with .Values.apiServer.hpa.behavior }}
+  behavior: {{- toYaml . | nindent 4 }}
+  {{- end }}
+{{- end }}

+    matchLabels:
+      tier: airflow
+      component: execution-api-server

+##########################################
+## Airflow Execution API Server Service
+##########################################
+{{- if and .Values.apiServer.enabled .Values.splitApiServersIntoCoreAndExecution }}
+apiVersion: v1
+kind: Service
+metadata:
+  name: {{ include "airflow.fullname" . }}-execution-api-server
+  labels:
+    tier: airflow
+    component: execution-api-server
+    release: {{ .Release.Name }}
+    chart: "{{ .Chart.Name }}-{{ .Chart.Version }}"
+    heritage: {{ .Release.Service }}
+    {{- if or .Values.labels .Values.apiServer.labels }}
+      {{- mustMerge .Values.apiServer.labels .Values.labels | toYaml | nindent 4 }}
+    {{- end }}
+  {{- with .Values.apiServer.service.annotations }}
+  annotations: {{- toYaml . | nindent 4 }}
+  {{- end }}
+spec:
+  # The execution API server is intended to be reachable only by in-cluster
+  # Airflow components (workers, triggerer, dag-processor, scheduler). Pin the
+  # service type to ClusterIP so that operators who expose the public API via
+  # LoadBalancer/NodePort on `apiServer.service.type` do not accidentally
+  # publish the execution surface to the same network.
+  type: ClusterIP
+  selector:
+    tier: airflow
+    component: execution-api-server
+    release: {{ .Release.Name }}
+  ports:
+  {{ range .Values.apiServer.service.ports }}
+    -
+      {{- range $key, $val := . }}
+      {{ $key }}: {{ tpl (toString $val) $ }}
+      {{- end }}
+  {{- end }}
+{{- end }}

 airflowVersion: "3.2.2"
 
+# Run the Core API Server (public/UI traffic) and Execution API Server
+# (internal worker/triggerer/dag-processor traffic) as two separate
+# Deployments. When true:
+#   * The existing api-server Deployment is restricted to `--apps core`.
+#   * A new `<release>-execution-api-server` Deployment + ClusterIP Service
+#     is created with `--apps execution`. The Service is pinned to ClusterIP
+#     so the internal surface is not exposed even if `apiServer.service.type`
+#     is LoadBalancer/NodePort.
+#   * `[core] execution_api_server_url` is rewritten to point at the new
+#     internal Service.
+# Both Deployments share `apiServer.*` settings today (replicas, hpa, pdb,
+# resources, network policy, etc.). Customizing `apiServer.args` is
+# supported in two ways:
+#   * Standard form (`["bash", "-c", "exec airflow api-server <extra-flags>"]`):
+#     the chart appends `--apps core` / `--apps execution` for you, preserving
+#     `<extra-flags>` (e.g. `--proxy-headers`).
+#   * Explicit `--apps` (e.g. `--apps all` or `--apps core,execution`): the
+#     chart trusts your args verbatim and applies them to both Deployments
+#     unchanged. Use this only if you intentionally want to opt out of the
+#     split for one or both Deployments.
+# Args that match neither shape will cause `helm template` to fail rather
+# than silently leaving the core Deployment serving the execution app.
+splitApiServersIntoCoreAndExecution: false
+
